format.time_domain: monotonic_ns; int64; one clock_id per event stream

reference.detector: per-session adaptive RMS against max(minimum_dbfs, noise_dbfs + noise_margin_db)
reference.probability: sigmoid((dbfs - threshold) / 3 dB), known probability in [0,1]
reference.detection: two consecutive active frames for onset, three inactive frames for offset
reference.analysis: timestamped speech_probability and speech_event on the proposed analysis-event model
reference.public_boundary: optional task-local provider using audio_sdk/provider_v0.h and audio_sdk/session_v0.h only; audio passthrough, no analysis in v0 ABI

invariants: The installed v0 ABI, descriptors, registry defaults, CONTRACTS.md, CMakeLists.txt and behavior are unchanged.
Each session owns its noise estimate, detection state, events, dropped-event audit and monotonic availability clock.
Source intervals are exact half-open sample ranges; cross-hop placement uses exact overlap, never hop rounding.
Known zero probability is nonspeech; invalid/nonfinite/out-of-range probability is invalid analysis and is never nonspeech; unknown is retained but excluded.
Stale epochs, pre-stream intervals, wrong clocks, nonmonotonic availability, malformed frames and nonfinite samples are rejected explicitly.
The historical adapter declares 320-sample frames; this v0 fixture uses 160 and does not claim numeric parity.
No real assets, corpora, downloads, licensed runtimes, device timing or listening results are included.
public_v0_abi: unchanged; provider source is opt-in and not registered or installed by default
